title: About
description: Professional background, working style, and technology focus.

summary.title: Professional summary
summary.body: I am a senior mobile and frontend engineer focused on React Native, React, and TypeScript. I care about clear architecture, accessible interfaces, and shipping reliable product experiences.

approach.title: Development approach
approach.body: I start from the user problem, keep the codebase understandable, and iterate with small, reviewable changes. I prefer typed models, reusable UI primitives, and feature-oriented structure over premature abstraction.

points.0: Clarify product goals before expanding technical complexity
points.1: Favor maintainable architecture and readable TypeScript
points.2: Validate UI across breakpoints, themes, and text directions
points.3: Ship incrementally with strong feedback loops

0.title: Cross-platform delivery
0.body: Comfortable moving between React Native and React while keeping shared product thinking.

1.title: Interface craft
1.body: Attention to hierarchy, spacing, accessibility, and responsive behavior.

2.title: Engineering clarity
2.body: Typed data models, simple composition, and code that another developer can extend quickly.

3.title: Collaboration
3.body: Practical communication with design and product partners around trade-offs and delivery.

ai.title: AI-assisted development workflow
ai.body: I use AI coding agents as accelerators for exploration, boilerplate reduction, and review support — while keeping architecture decisions, validation, and final quality ownership with the engineer.

points.0: Draft and refine implementations faster without skipping design judgment
points.1: Use AI to surface alternatives, edge cases, and test ideas
points.2: Keep secrets, correctness, and product intent under human control

focus.title: Technology focus
focus.body: Current focus areas that show up consistently in my work.
